# Documents

This folder contains the raw, paginated text extractions from the 2023 and 2024 annual reports of the Danish ADHD Database (ADHD-databasen). The documents capture the complete contents of both PDFs, including executive summaries, national and regional quality indicator results for child, adolescent, and adult psychiatry, methodology descriptions, and steering committee appendices. These chunks serve as the foundational source material for all entity, topic, and comparison pages in the wiki, preserving the exact text and pagination for citation purposes.

## Pages

- [[adhd-2023-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, and executive conclusions for the 2023 ADHD Database annual report.
- [[adhd-2023-part-002]] — National indicator overview, aggregate results, and the beginning of Indicator 1 (somatic assessment) data.
- [[adhd-2023-part-003]] — Regional and departmental data tables and forest plots for Indicator 1, plus the definition of Indicator 2a.
- [[adhd-2023-part-004]] — Results and discussion for Indicator 2a (environmental observation for 0-5 year olds), and the start of Indicator 2b data.
- [[adhd-2023-part-005]] — Results for Indicator 2b (diagnostic interview/observation for 6-17 year olds) and the definition of Indicator 3.
- [[adhd-2023-part-006]] — Data tables and forest plots for Indicator 3 (diagnostic conference), plus the definition of Indicator 4.
- [[adhd-2023-part-007]] — Results and discussion for Indicator 3, followed by regional and departmental data tables for Indicator 4 (network meetings).
- [[adhd-2023-part-008]] — Results for Indicator 4, plus the definition and initial data tables for Indicator 5 (psychoeducation).
- [[adhd-2023-part-009]] — Results and forest plots for Indicator 5, followed by the definition and data tables for Indicator 6 (pharmacological treatment).
- [[adhd-2023-part-010]] — Results for Indicator 6, outcome indicators 7a/7b (school exams), disease description, methodology, and appendices.
- [[adhd-2023-part-011]] — Blank final page of the 2023 report extraction.
- [[adhd-2024-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, and executive conclusions for the 2024 report, noting the inclusion of adult and private hospital data.
- [[adhd-2024-part-002]] — Indicator overview and aggregate national results for both child/adolescent and adult populations.
- [[adhd-2024-part-003]] — Detailed regional and departmental data tables for Indicator 1 (somatic assessment) in children and adolescents.
- [[adhd-2024-part-004]] — Results and discussion for Indicator 1, plus the definition and data tables for Indicator 2a.
- [[adhd-2024-part-005]] — Results for Indicator 2a, followed by the definition and data tables for Indicator 2b.
- [[adhd-2024-part-006]] — Results and discussion for Indicator 2b, plus the definition and data tables for Indicator 3 (diagnostic conference).
- [[adhd-2024-part-007]] — Results for Indicator 3, followed by the definition and data tables for Indicator 4 (network meetings).
- [[adhd-2024-part-008]] — Results and discussion for Indicator 4, plus the definition and data tables for Indicator 5 (psychoeducation).
- [[adhd-2024-part-009]] — Results for Indicator 5, followed by the definition and data tables for Indicator 6 (pharmacological treatment).
- [[adhd-2024-part-010]] — Results for Indicator 6, outcome indicators 7a/7b (school exams), and the introduction to the new adult indicators.
- [[adhd-2024-part-011]] — Data tables and results for adult Indicator 8 (psychoeducation), plus the definition of Indicator 9.
- [[adhd-2024-part-012]] — Data tables and results for adult Indicator 9 (psychotherapy), plus the definition of Indicator 10.
- [[adhd-2024-part-013]] — Data tables and results for adult Indicator 10 (social support needs), plus the definition of Indicator 11.
- [[adhd-2024-part-014]] — Results for adult Indicator 11 (pharmacological treatment), disease description, methodology, steering committee, and appendices.
- [[adhd-2024-part-015]] — Blank final page of the 2024 report extraction.
